claim: Foreign fee commitments are reserved per resting order; liquidation repayment clamps spot-attributed debt to remaining total debt.
A market sweep reserves third-asset fees for every predicted maker execution, not one aggregate reference-price fill.
Same-timestamp derivative expiry settlement announcements are symbol-sorted; expiry settlement precedes the option liquidation sweep.
Terminal shutdown is idempotent, stopped scheduled gateways drop stale outputs, and actor stop cannot double-close.
Vet, static correctness analysis, full/race suites, and repeated invariant fuzzing found no remaining violation in this bounded campaign.
